flags.why: The first example incorrectly places the offended person as the subject of mất lòng, which means to cause displeasure ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-m%E1%BA%A5t%20l%C3%B2ng)).
flags.fix: Nói thẳng như vậy dễ làm mất lòng người ta. = Speaking so bluntly can easily offend people.

flags.why: This reverses the meaning: mất lòng means to offend someone, not to feel offended ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-m%E1%BA%A5t%20l%C3%B2ng)).
The respectful meaning refers to a deceased teacher, not generally to scholars of former times ([dictionary](https://www.hanzi.live/hanvi/ti%C3%AAn%20s%C6%B0)).
The example explains the grammatical term instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Cô giáo yêu cầu chúng tôi xác định phần thuyết trong từng câu. = The teacher asked us to identify the comment in each sentence.

flags.why: The common verb meaning to restrain or hold back is missing ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/kim-e1gaJrzCJXAuV.html)).
flags.fix: verb | to restrain; to hold back

flags.why: The everyday insulting adjective meaning crazy or daft is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/h%E1%BA%A5p)).
The familiar meaning of not yet having children, as in vợ chồng son, is missing ([dictionary](https://www.caodaism.org/e-book-pdf/TuNgu-DienCo-CaoDai%28v2018_0%29_Q2.pdf)).
flags.fix: adj | not yet having children (of a married person or couple)

flags.why: The Vietnamese says pistol without specifying that it is a revolver.
flags.fix: The museum displays an old pistol.

flags.why: The example explains how the stroke is drawn instead of showing the term in use.
flags.fix: Em viết sai nét hất trong chữ này. = You wrote the rising stroke incorrectly in this character.

flags.why: The common meaning describing a person who avoids social interaction or sharing feelings is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kh%C3%A9p_k%C3%ADn)).
